regime.label: Selloff, stressed
regime.summary: S&P 500 about 7,214 (-1.5%) at 13:13 ET, sixth loss in a row; Dow about -2%. AMD -8% on a short report, UNH -5.5% again, hawkish Fed talk and Anthropic's IPO fading. Philly Fed 6.3 vs 18 expected.

brief: The early bounce turned into a broad selloff: the S&P 500 is about -1.5% and the Dow is down about 1,000 points, with the VIX near 27. Today: sell Cerebras if not done, no lab trade, keep limit orders as they are, and do not sell long-term holdings on this drop.

todo.focus: Sell Cerebras (stop hit). No lab trade, no rocket. Anthropic debuts: don't chase.

items.text: Do NOT buy Anthropic (ANT) on its first day, even if it flies
CBRS closed $94.15, under the $100 stop: SELL after 19:00 Dubai if not done yet
Lab: no trade today. Palo Alto, Take-Two and Intel rejected (chase / day-2 hype)
SPYM: next weekly buy uses a limit at or below the last close ($85.97), not $91

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at CHF 170, valid until Fri Nov 27. About CHF 179.60 Thu, 5% above the limit: not filled. Do not chase. SIX, or ADR CFRUY.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: The $335 limit likely filled (low $332.42 Wed). If not filled, keep it until Fri Nov 20; cancel if ETN closes below $327.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 29% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: The $86.22 limit likely filled (low $85.55 Wed). Next weekly buy: 6 SPYM with a limit at or below the previous close ($85.97), never above it.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. About 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. Fell on a profit miss partly from a one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the EUR 48.50 limit if placed. Reconsider Fri Nov 27 only if IFX closed above EUR 46 every day and no new US chip rule hits Europe.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide (about EUR 1.8bn) is below the EUR 2bn hoped for.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT: BUY 2 only with a limit at EUR 235 (about EUR 242.50 Thu), valid until Fri Nov 27. Paris hours 12:00-20:30 Dubai, or US OTC SBGSY.
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. Closed $362.62 Wed. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM at or below that close if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%. Cheap at about 15x next year's profit, but not yet a buy.

cards.name: Intuit
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy on results day (tonight, 01:00 Dubai). Reconsider at the Mon Nov 23 close, only if no guide line is cut.
cards.story: Down about 9% in two days on AI fear. Core growth is slowing: online paying customers +3%, FY27 revenue guide only +9-10%.

cards.name: UnitedHealth, Humana
cards.trigger: WATCH UNH and HUM. No buy: the rule can cut payments and its size is unknown. Reconsider after comments close (Jan 19, 2027).
cards.story: Down 10-13% on a proposed Medicare audit rule. The businesses were improving, but an unsized clawback is a real risk.

cards.name: Luxury: LVMH, Moncler
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy while LVMH Fashion & Leather shrinks. Reconsider after LVMH full-year results (late Jan 2027).
cards.story: LVMH about 40% below its high, Moncler at a 4-year low. Part mood, but LVMH Fashion & Leather fell 5% organic in Q3.

cards.name: AMD
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy while the export question is open. Reconsider only if AMD answers the report and the stock closes back above $520.
cards.story: Down about 8% on a short seller's China firmware report. Data center +97%, but gaming -40% and an export probe could hit sales.

cards.name: Williams-Sonoma
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before the FY27 guidance in March 2027. Reconsider only if Pottery Barn growth recovers and management restates its long-term plan.
cards.story: Down 8-11% on a small sales miss and a kept guide. Comps +5.1%, but Pottery Barn grew only +1.8%.

cards.name: ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: new US chip export rule. Reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) if the 2027 sales view is above EUR 50bn.
cards.story: Record Q3 sales EUR 11.7bn and the 2026 guide floor raised. But a new US rule limits where customers can sell, and China is about 20% of revenue.

cards.name: Vertiv
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: AI-infra exposure and slowing AI capex forecasts. Reconsider after Q4 results (Feb 2027) if organic growth stays above 40%.
cards.story: Down 6.6% Nov 16 with no news, about 47% below its high. Q3 sales +61% (55% organic), but EMEA organic is -3.3% over nine months.
